320 illustrated sport safety posters for teens and student athletes. Open an image to view it at full size, or download it for printing.

Dedicated safety posters for all 20 listed sports. These do not replace individual injury assessment or return-to-play clearance. Collection review and listed revisions approved by Alex Ehsan, MD, PhD on September 28, 2026.
